title: Binance to Delist UST/BTC Trading Pair and Add BTC/UST Trading Pair
text: Fellow Binancians , Binance will remove and cease trading on the UST/BTC trading pair, and then open trading for the BTC/UST trading pair, with the following timeline:  At 2022-04-14 03:00 (UTC), Binance will suspend UST/BTC isolated margin borrowing. At 2022-04-20 03:00 (UTC), Binance will close all UST/BTC margin positions, conduct an automatic settlement and cancel all pending orders on the UST/BTC isolated margin pair, and then delist the UST/BTC isolated margin trading pair. Binance will remove and cease trading on the UST/BTC spot trading pair at 2022-04-22 03:00 (UTC), and all pending spot trade orders on the pair will be canceled. Binance will open trading for the BTC/UST spot trading pair at 2022-04-22 09:00 (UTC), and the BTC/UST isolated margin pair at 2022-04-25 03:00 (UTC). Please note: In the interim, users can still trade the above assets on other trading pairs that are available on Binance.
